name: Box Spawner

boxesPerMinute.label: Feed rate
boxesPerMinute.desc: Boxes per minute. 0 halts the feed without pausing the part, so the timer restarts cleanly when you raise it again.

fixedRate.label: Fixed rate (off = ±50% jitter)
fixedRate.desc: On, boxes arrive on an exact metronome. Off, each gap is randomised between half and one-and-a-half times the nominal period, which is what an untidy real feed looks like downstream.

boxColor.label: Box color
boxColor.desc: Tint for every spawned box. Ignored once the cycle list below is non-empty.

boxColors.label: Box colors (cycle)
boxColors.desc: Colors handed out one per box, in order, overriding the single color above. Useful for telling sorted lanes apart at a glance. Leave empty to use the single colour.

randomColors.label: Random color order
randomColors.desc: Draw each colour at random from the cycle list instead of walking the list in order.

length.label: Box length (m)
length.desc: Extent along local X of each spawned box. Ignored while Random size is on.

width.label: Box width (m)
width.desc: Extent along local Z of each spawned box. Ignored while Random size is on.

height.label: Box height (m)
height.desc: Extent along local Y of each spawned box. Ignored while Random size is on.

randomSize.label: Random size
randomSize.desc: Give each box a random size and IGNORE the three dimensions above. The random range is fixed by the part (0.4-0.8 long, 0.3-0.5 high, 0.3-0.5 wide), not derived from them.

mass.label: Mass (kg)
mass.desc: Mass given to every spawned box, whatever its size.

disable.label: Paused
disable.desc: Stop spawning entirely. Use (C, or E while walking) is a separate hand stop: it pauses and resumes the feed during a run without changing this setting, and is cleared when the run stops.

keepSpacing.label: Keep spacing while held
keepSpacing.desc: Hold the interval while the feed is held instead of letting it run down, so boxes dropped onto a conveyor that stops with this spawner (give both the same run tag) stay one pitch apart however often the pair stops.

conveyorId.label: Pause when conveyor stopped
conveyorId.desc: Interlock: while the named conveyor is stopped, this spawner holds. Wire that conveyor to the PLC and the feed gates itself, with no tag of its own.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

runTag.label: Run tag (spawn only while true)
runTag.desc: Gate the feed from the program. Note this only takes over once a program actually DRIVES the tag - until then the spawner keeps running, so a merely-declared tag is not a stopped feed.

countTag.label: Spawned count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of boxes this spawner has dispensed. Subtract the despawner counts to get the work in progress.
